name: Weapon Specialist
description: Gain proficiency with one weapon set. When using a weapon from a proficient weapon set, gain its associated weapon mastery effect.

name: Quick Draw
description: You may draw, stow, or switch between weapons without using your Move action.

name: Versatile Fighter
description: When making a Might Strike, you may use the special property of the weapon set associated with the card you played, provided you are wielding an appropriate weapon.

name: Combat Adaptation
description: Once per turn, after playing a card for an attack, you may change the weapon used for the attack before determining its final effect.

name: Powerful Strike
description: When you hit with a melee weapon using a card matching the weapon's suit, deal 1 additional HP.

name: Guard Breaker
description: When you hit an enemy with a melee attack, you may sacrifice the weapon's additional damage or mastery effect to force the target to lose its defensive advantage or appropriate guard.

name: Riposte
description: When an enemy misses you with a melee attack, you may burn a card to make an immediate melee attack against that enemy.

name: Card Fighter
description: Once per short rest, when you play a card for a melee attack, you may immediately draw one card after the attack resolves.

name: Master of Arms
description: You may use the mastery effect of any weapon set you are proficient with, allowing you to choose between additional damage or the weapon's special effect when appropriate.

name: Weaponmaster
description: Once per turn, when you make a weapon attack, you may treat the card played as matching the suit of your weapon for the purpose of triggering its weapon mastery effect.

name: Bow Training
description: Gain proficiency with Clubs weapons. When using a bow, you may use Dexterity for your attack.

name: Steady Aim
description: If you do not use your Move action during your turn, your next ranged attack gains an appropriate bonus determined by the GM.

name: Hunter's Eye
description: Gain proficiency in Perception or Survival. When tracking or observing a creature from a distance, you may ask the GM one additional useful question.

name: Skirmisher
description: After making a ranged attack, you may move a short distance without provoking an appropriate reaction from the target.

name: Called Shot
description: When making a ranged attack, you may declare a specific target such as a hand, weapon, leg, or exposed object. On a hit, the GM may apply an appropriate secondary effect instead of the normal weapon mastery effect.

name: Volley
description: Burn an additional card when making a ranged attack to affect a second nearby target. Make a separate attack check against the second target.

name: Covering Fire
description: Burn a card to create a zone of threatening ranged fire. The first enemy that moves through the area before your next turn may trigger a ranged attack from you.

name: Hidden Archer
description: Gain proficiency in Stealth. When attacking from a hidden position, you may gain an appropriate bonus or additional effect determined by the GM.

name: Party Scout
description: During exploration, you may designate yourself as the party's scout. Gain an advantage or other appropriate benefit when detecting ambushes, tracking creatures, or identifying distant threats.

name: Master Archer
description: When making a ranged attack from a hidden position, you may treat the card played as matching the suit of your bow for the purpose of triggering its weapon mastery effect.
